text:
You need manual online research on about 2,000 Canadian company names and then entry of the datapoints into a Google Sheet.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, and I can help with a workflow that combines careful manual research with light automation where it fits. On a legal project, I built a contract clause search assistant that answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page used; clause lookup dropped from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. For healthcare, I built a clinical note summarisation model that drafted visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs were masked, and clinician editing time went down 38% in a 6-week trial.

For your task, I’d focus on accuracy, consistency, and clean sheet entry rather than trying to over-automate what needs human checking. Which datapoints do you need collected for each company?
